item.title: Two Charleston Restaurants Make The New York Times’ 2025 Best Restaurant Dishes List
item.description: Two Charleston restaurants were included on The New York Times’ list of the country’s Best Restaurant Dishes for 2025. The Holy City was represented by the blowfish tails from Chubby Fish and the beef cheeks from Palmira Barbecue.

item.title: World-Famous Blue Angels to Headline 2026 Charleston Air Show
item.description: This week, Joint Base Charleston announced that the world-famous Blue Angels will headline the 2026 Charleston Airshow, which will be held May 2 and 3.

item.title: Charleston Restaurants & Bars Open on Christmas and Christmas Eve 2025
item.description: I've started a list of Charleston restaurants that will be open on Christmas*. This is definitely not a complete list, so if you know of any additions, please let me know (christian@holycitysinner.com)!

item.title: Charleston Restaurants Offering Christmas/Holiday Dinner To Go (2025 Edition)
item.description: If you don't feel like cooking for Christmas, several businesses will be offering dinner to-go!

item.title: South Carolina Shut Out by Orlando, 5-0
item.description: The South Carolina Stingrays fell to the Orlando Solar Bears, 5-0, on Saturday evening at the North Charleston Coliseum in front of 4,563 fans.

item.title: UNice Wear and Go Wigs: Your No-Stress Guide to Looking Instantly Fire
item.description: Okay, let’s be real. The wig world can be low-key overwhelming. Between the glue, the lace trimming, the hours of blending… it’s a whole vibe, and not always the fun kind. If you’re a wig newbie or just someone who can’t be bothered with a 2-hour install, we see you. Enter: UNice wear and go wigs. These are literally what they sound like—the easiest, glueless wig hack for when you wanna look like you put in effort, but actually didn’t.
